title: How Blockbuster Lost to a $50 Million Offer
description: In 2000, Netflix offered itself to Blockbuster. Here's what happened next.

scenes.narration: In the year 2000, three men walked into a Dallas office with an offer that could have changed everything.
The price was fifty million dollars. Blockbuster laughed them out of the room.
At its peak, Blockbuster ran over nine thousand stores and made billions from late fees alone.
Customers hated those fees. One executive later called them a tax on forgetting.

overlay.text: It was a tax on forgetting.

scenes.narration: By 2010 the company filed for bankruptcy. Netflix was worth billions.
